findings.title: False evidence claim in the PR body: the 6 new Sonar issues can be read as check-run annotations, but the body says they cannot, and they have no disposition (AGENTS.md:56 unmet)
findings.evidence: PR body, 'Review findings and coverage' section: "The issue list could not be read from this container: sonarcloud.io is blocked by the egress policy (CONNECT 403). The check-run output has no annotations." It sets 'Disposition: open', leaves '[ ] Inspected findings and threads on the final head' unchecked, and lists the Sonar issue list under 'Not verified here'. Both claims are false. From this same container, without auth, `curl https://api.github.com/repos/optomachina/Overdrafter/check-runs/111510011176` returns head_sha ab659ddd41d021b65e7e4f659c1399538c24d7f1 and output.annotations_count=6 (app sonarqubecloud). `GET .../check-runs/111510011176/annotations?per_page=100` returns all six, each titled 'Add the AS keyword prior to the column alias.': supabase/tests/founding_beta_subscription_bypass.sql:168 x2 (AaEHX3pvg7hdaRA9EPjU, ...EPjV), :419 x2 (...EPjX, ...EPjW), :445 (...EPjY), :446 (...EPjZ). Those lines hold PostgreSQL typed interval literals: `now() + interval '30 days', now() - interval '1 day'` (168), `clock_timestamp() - interval '1 hour', clock_timestamp() + interval '2 hours'` (419), `now() - interval '1 day'` (445), `now() + interval '30 days'` (446). Sonar's SQL grammar misreads each as a column with an alias. AGENTS.md:56 requires that 'At the final PR head, inspect the Sonar issue list ... record the gap and its disposition.' The list was available, so the stated reason for skipping that step does not hold. The issues themselves are style-only false positives, and no code defect is implied.
findings.suggested_fix: PR-body-only fix (optionally plus comments). Replace the false sentences. Record the six annotations with a disposition (false positive: a PostgreSQL `interval '<n> <unit>'` typed literal, not a column alias). Alternatively, add `-- NOSONAR` on lines 168, 419, 445 and 446, following the repository precedent at supabase/tests/quote_provider_admission_registry.sql:329 and capability_observation_rpcs.sql:58. Then tick the 'Inspected findings' box and remove the Sonar items from 'Follow-up items' and 'Not verified here'.
